White-winged angelic man, his right side pristine and gleaming, his left side blackened and withered.

AC 21 (+2 plate and +2 shield), HP 100, ATK 4 +3 spear +10 (1d6+3) and baleful beauty, MV double near (fly), S +5, D +4, C +6, I +3, W +4, Ch +6, AL C, LV 21

Baleful Beauty. Radiate beauty, all mortals within double near, CHA 18+ or rush to kiss and touch Belial for 1d4 rounds.

Hedonistic Hope. When a creature gains a beneficial emotional or morale effect within double near of Belial, he may choose to have the effect also aid him.

Impervious. Fire and cold immune. Only damaged by silver or magical sources.

Reflexive Shapeshifter. 1/round, Belial shapeshifts when critically hit, turning a critical hit into a normal hit.
